description: Create a handoff task: a unit of work with an owner, a lifecycle (queued, claimed, completed), and an optional human/agent approval gate. Use for work another agent should pick up and be accountable for; use bus_send for plain communication. Optionally assign it, mark it urgent, or list task ids it is blocked by.

agent.description: Your registered agent name (the task creator).

assignee.description: Agent name the task is intended for. Leave unset to put it in the open queue for anyone to claim.

blockedBy.description: Ids of tasks that must complete before this one can be claimed.

body.description: Details, context, and acceptance criteria for whoever claims the task.

needsApproval.description: When true, the task waits in needs-approval and cannot be claimed until bus_approve_task releases it.

priority.description: Task priority. "urgent" tasks surface first in wake probes and the board.

title.description: Short task title: what needs doing.

name: bus_create_task
